_comment: REFRAMED 2026-10-01: Pro (1.6T) is the SAME DSv4 arch as Flash, so it REUSES Flash's authored kernels as DONORS (wiring+validation, NOT new-kernel authoring). It is too large for one GNR node at tp=1 (~800GB native MXFP4 > one 256GB NUMA domain and > the 768GB socket -> can only run TP>=2, the decode-hostile config measured 2.8x slower on Flash); its realistic home is a MULTI-SOCKET EMR cluster (Kimi-K3-style TP/EP/PP). The GNR-TP4 numbers below are an earlier ANALYTICAL estimate, NOT a result; the multi-socket roofline is TBD. ORIGINAL NOTE (superseded in part by compute-from-native-precision, which keeps experts native MXFP4 instead of the fp4->bf16 dequant assumed here): PUBLISHED-TARGET for DeepSeek-V4-PRO (the 1.6T / 49B-activated model), SNC-corrected like the Flash artifact. Pro decode is weight-streaming bound and near-saturated (batching buys little): model-roofline-analysis worked example gives B=32 ~58 tok/s on the FULL 2-socket node; SNC-effective = x4/6 (TP=4 of 6 domains, heads not div by 6) -> ~38.7 tok/s.
node: gnr_6980p (SNC-on: 6 NUMA domains; TP=4 = 4/6 domains; effective 841/1261 GB/s)

ops.note: 1.6T model near-saturated at B=32 (~half the model streamed/step); the model bound. full-node ref ~63 x4/6
